title: Taiwan Stocks Plunge 6% as Regulator Tightens Short-Selling Rules
summaryZh: 台股重挫6.23%，金管會祭出限空令穩定市場。
summaryHi: ताइवान का शेयर बाज़ार 6.23% गिरा; नियामक ने शॉर्ट-सेलिंग पर नए प्रतिबंध लगाए।
summaryEs: La bolsa de Taiwán cae un 6,23 % y el regulador limita las ventas en corto.
summaryJa: 台湾株が6.23%急落、金融監督管理委員会が空売り規制を強化。
summaryKo: 대만 증시 6.23% 급락, 금융감독관리위원회 공매도 규제 강화.
summaryEn: Taiwan's Taiex plunged 6.23% as the FSC introduced new curbs on short-selling.
paragraphs: Taiwan's stock market endured one of its worst days in recent memory on Friday, as the benchmark Taiex plunged 2,393.60 points, or 6.23 percent, to close at 36,033.29. Turnover reached NT$877 billion (about US$26.6 billion).

The sell-off deepened losses from Thursday, when the index tumbled 4.4 percent and fell below the 40,000 mark. That drop, the seventh-largest in points on record, was blamed on weakness in American technology shares.

In response, the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) introduced extra measures that took effect on Friday, adding to a five-point package announced on November 9. Most of them target short-selling, a strategy in which investors sell borrowed shares in the hope of buying them back later at a lower price.

Any stock that falls by 3.5 percent or more in one session can no longer be short-sold below the previous close in the next session. The daily limit on short orders using borrowed shares was also cut from 3 percent to 1 percent of a stock's average trading volume. Brokers and futures firms that trade for hedging are exempt.

The regulator also urged banks and insurers to buy shares in financially sound companies and encouraged firms to buy back their own stock. It insisted that market fundamentals remain solid, pointing to record company revenue, but admitted that uncertainty had shaken investor confidence.
Taiwan's stock market had a very bad day on Friday. The main index fell 6.23 percent. It closed at 36,033 points.
On Thursday, the index also fell by 4.4 percent. It went below 40,000 points. Many people sold shares because tech stocks in the United States were weak.

A government office, the Financial Supervisory Commission, wanted to stop the fall. It made new rules from Friday. Some people sell borrowed shares and hope the price goes down. This is called short-selling.
Now, if a stock falls 3.5 percent or more in one day, people cannot short-sell it below the last price the next day. The office also asked banks to buy shares in good companies.
The office says Taiwan's companies are still strong. But many investors are worried.
sentZh: 台灣股市週五非常慘。
主要指數下跌 6.23%。
週四指數也下跌了 4.4%。
因為美國科技股表現疲弱，很多人賣出股票。
政府機關金融監督管理委員會想阻止下跌。
它從週五起實施新規定。
有些人會賣出借來的股票，希望價格下跌。
這叫做放空。
現在如果一檔股票一天下跌 3.5% 以上，隔天就不能用低於前一個價格放空。
金管會也請銀行買進好公司的股票。
金管會說台灣的公司仍然很強健。
但許多投資人很擔心。

paragraphs: Taiwan's stock market suffered another heavy loss on Friday, November 20. The main index, the Taiex, dropped 2,393 points, or 6.23 percent, and closed at 36,033.
The fall came one day after a 4.4 percent drop on Thursday, when the index went below the important 40,000 level. Thursday's fall was linked to weak technology stocks in the United States.

To calm the market, the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) announced new measures that started on Friday. The main one is about short-selling, when investors sell borrowed shares because they expect the price to fall.

Under the new rule, if a stock loses 3.5 percent or more in one day, it cannot be short-sold below the previous closing price in the next session. The FSC also reduced the number of borrowed shares that can be sold in one day and asked financial companies to buy shares in healthy firms.
The FSC said Taiwan's listed companies are earning record revenue. However, it admitted that political and economic uncertainty has damaged investors' confidence.
sentZh: 台灣股市在 11 月 20 日週五再度重挫。
主要指數台股加權指數下跌 2,393 點、跌幅 6.23%，收在 36,033 點。
這次下跌發生在週四重挫 4.4% 的隔天，當時指數跌破重要的 40,000 點關卡。
週四的下跌與美國科技股疲弱有關。
為了穩定市場，金融監督管理委員會（金管會）宣布週五起實施新措施。
最主要的一項與放空有關，也就是投資人預期股價下跌而賣出借來的股票。
根據新規定，若一檔股票單日下跌 3.5% 以上，下一個交易日就不能以低於前一日收盤價放空。
金管會也減少了單日可賣出的借券數量，並請金融業者買進體質健全公司的股票。
金管會表示，台灣上市公司的營收創下新高。
不過它也承認，政治和經濟的不確定性已打擊投資人的信心。

paragraphs: Taiwan's stock market endured one of its worst days in recent memory on Friday, as the benchmark Taiex plunged 2,393.60 points, or 6.23 percent, to close at 36,033.29. Turnover reached NT$877 billion (about US$26.6 billion).

The sell-off deepened losses from Thursday, when the index tumbled 4.4 percent and fell below the 40,000 mark. That drop, the seventh-largest in points on record, was blamed on weakness in American technology shares.

In response, the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) introduced extra measures that took effect on Friday, adding to a five-point package announced on November 9. Most of them target short-selling, a strategy in which investors sell borrowed shares in the hope of buying them back later at a lower price.

Any stock that falls by 3.5 percent or more in one session can no longer be short-sold below the previous close in the next session. The daily limit on short orders using borrowed shares was also cut from 3 percent to 1 percent of a stock's average trading volume. Brokers and futures firms that trade for hedging are exempt.

The regulator also urged banks and insurers to buy shares in financially sound companies and encouraged firms to buy back their own stock. It insisted that market fundamentals remain solid, pointing to record company revenue, but admitted that uncertainty had shaken investor confidence.
sentZh: 台股週五經歷近年來最慘烈的日子之一，加權指數暴跌 2,393.60 點、跌幅 6.23%，收在 36,033.29 點。
成交金額達新台幣 8,770 億元（約 266 億美元）。
這波拋售加深了週四的跌勢，當天指數重挫 4.4%，跌破 40,000 點大關。
那次跌點數是史上第七大，被歸咎於美國科技股走弱。
金融監督管理委員會（金管會）隨即推出週五生效的額外措施，作為 11 月 9 日公布的五項方案的補充。
其中大部分針對放空，也就是投資人賣出借來的股票，希望日後以更低價買回。
任何單日跌幅達 3.5% 以上的股票，下一個交易日不得以低於前一日收盤價放空。
以借券進行的單日放空委託上限，也從個股平均成交量的 3% 降到 1%。
為避險而交易的券商與期貨商不受此限。
監管機關也敦促銀行和保險公司買進財務健全公司的股票，並鼓勵企業買回自家股票。
金管會堅稱市場基本面依然穩固，並以企業營收創新高為證，但也承認不確定性已動搖投資人信心。

paragraphs: Taiwan's equity market suffered a second consecutive rout on Friday, with the Taiex shedding 2,393.60 points, or 6.23 percent, to settle at 36,033.29 on turnover of roughly NT$877 billion.

Friday's slide compounded a 4.4 percent decline the previous day, which had pushed the index below the psychologically significant 40,000 threshold. Thursday's fall, attributed largely to a slump in US technology stocks, ranked as the seventh-largest single-day drop in points in the market's history.

Seeking to restore stability, the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) unveiled a fresh set of curbs that came into force on Friday, supplementing five measures introduced on November 9. The new rules focus primarily on short-selling, whereby traders sell borrowed shares in anticipation of repurchasing them more cheaply.

Shares that drop 3.5 percent or more in a session are now barred from being shorted below the prior close during the following session, and the restriction is extended if the decline continues. Meanwhile, the daily ceiling on intraday short orders involving borrowed stock has been slashed from 3 percent to 1 percent of average volume, although market makers and hedging activity are exempt.

The regulator further called on financial institutions to purchase stakes in fundamentally sound companies and on listed firms to repurchase shares; 39 companies already had buyback schemes worth up to NT$27.4 billion. While maintaining that fundamentals are robust, the FSC conceded that political and economic uncertainty had eroded confidence.
sentZh: 台灣股市週五連續第二天崩跌，加權指數重挫 2,393.60 點、跌幅 6.23%，收在 36,033.29 點，成交金額約新台幣 8,770 億元。
週五的跌勢使前一天 4.4% 的跌幅雪上加霜，當時指數已跌破具心理意義的 40,000 點門檻。
週四的下跌主要歸因於美國科技股重挫，以點數計是台股史上第七大單日跌幅。
為恢復市場穩定，金融監督管理委員會（金管會）推出一套週五生效的新限制措施，補充 11 月 9 日實施的五項措施。
新規定主要針對放空，即交易人預期能以更低價買回而賣出借來的股票。
單日跌幅達 3.5% 以上的股票，在下一個交易日禁止以低於前一日收盤價放空，若跌勢持續，限制還會延長。
同時，涉及借券的盤中放空委託每日上限，從平均成交量的 3% 大砍至 1%，但造市者與避險交易不受此限。
監管機關還呼籲金融機構買進基本面健全公司的股份，並請上市公司買回庫藏股；已有 39 家公司在執行庫藏股計畫，金額上限達新台幣 274 億元。
金管會雖堅稱基本面穩健，但也坦承政治和經濟不確定性已削弱市場信心。

paragraphs: Investor sentiment in Taiwan deteriorated sharply on Friday as the Taiex recorded a precipitous fall of 6.23 percent, closing at 36,033.29 after losing almost 2,400 points in a single session.

This downturn followed a 4.4 percent decline on Thursday that dragged the index beneath the symbolically important level of 40,000. The earlier fall was linked chiefly to weakening technology valuations in the United States, a sector on which Taiwan's market depends heavily.

In an effort to curb volatility, the Financial Supervisory Commission implemented additional regulations from Friday onwards, building on a package unveiled earlier in the month. The centrepiece is a restriction on short-selling, a practice in which traders dispose of borrowed shares, anticipating that prices will decline so that they can repurchase them at a profit.

Specifically, any stock that depreciates by 3.5 percent or more in one session may not be shorted below its previous closing price in the subsequent session. Moreover, the permissible volume of daily short orders using borrowed shares has been reduced by two-thirds, from 3 percent to 1 percent of average turnover.

Although the commission maintains that corporate fundamentals are sound, citing record revenues among listed companies, it acknowledged that prevailing political and economic uncertainty has undermined confidence. Whether these interventions can arrest the slide remains to be seen.
sentZh: 台灣的投資人情緒週五急遽惡化，加權指數單日重挫 6.23%，失守近 2,400 點，收在 36,033.29 點。
這波下跌緊接在週四 4.4% 的跌幅之後，當時指數被拖累至具象徵意義的 40,000 點之下。
先前的下跌主要與美國科技股估值走弱有關，而台股相當倚重這個產業。
為抑制波動，金融監督管理委員會自週五起實施額外法規，延續本月稍早公布的一攬子方案。
核心措施是限制放空，也就是交易人預期股價下跌、日後能以低價買回獲利，而先賣出借來的股票。
具體而言，任何單日跌幅達 3.5% 以上的股票，在下一個交易日不得以低於前一日收盤價放空。
此外，以借券進行的每日放空委託允許量減少三分之二，從平均成交量的 3% 降至 1%。
儘管金管會堅稱企業基本面穩健，並指出上市公司營收創新高，但也承認當前的政治和經濟不確定性已削弱信心。
這些干預措施能否止住跌勢，仍有待觀察。
